field.label: Enable
field.help: Run the bandwidthd capture daemon.

field.label: Listen interface
field.help: The interface bandwidthd sniffs. Only one: the daemon opens a single pcap handle.

field.label: Local subnets
field.help: Interfaces whose subnets count as "local". Traffic between a local subnet and anything outside it is attributed to the local device.

field.label: Additional subnets
field.help: Extra IPv4 CIDR subnets to treat as local, separated by comma or space.

field.label: Promiscuous mode
field.help: See traffic that is not addressed to this host (needed on a mirrored/SPAN port).

field.label: Sensor name
field.help: Arbitrary label for this sensor. Defaults to the hostname.

field.label: Capture filter
field.help: Optional libpcap filter expression restricting what is counted.

field.label: Log CDF data
field.help: Write the CDF time series the dashboard reads. Turning this off leaves the dashboard with no data.

field.label: Recover CDF on start
field.help: Read existing CDF logs back on startup so history survives a restart.

field.label: Draw legacy graphs
field.help: Render bandwidthd's own PNG graphs. The dashboard does not use them; leave off unless you want the legacy HTML report.

field.label: Skip intervals
field.help: Intervals to skip between graph renders.

field.label: Graph cutoff (KB)
field.help: Minimum traffic before a host is graphed.

field.label: Enable traffic alerts
field.help: Evaluate the rules below every 15 minutes and log matches to the system log.

field.label: Interface daily quota (GB)
field.help: Alert when the interface total for the day exceeds this. 0 disables.

field.label: Per-device daily quota (GB)
field.help: Alert when any one device exceeds this in a day. 0 disables. Overridable per device.

field.label: Anomaly detection
field.help: Alert when a device's 24-hour traffic far exceeds its own recent average.

field.label: Anomaly factor
field.help: How many times the 7-day average counts as anomalous. Minimum 1.5; lower values are raised to it.

field.label: Exfiltration heuristic
field.help: Alert when a device's upload dominates its traffic — unusual for most clients.

field.label: New device alerts
field.help: Alert when a previously unseen MAC starts moving traffic.

field.label: Classification rules
field.help: One CIDR=tag rule per line, e.g. 10.0.50.0/24=iot. Highest-weighted classifier signal.

field.label: Active fingerprinting
field.help: Allow active probing (HTTP/TLS/mDNS/SSDP/banner) of LAN devices to identify them. Off by default; probes only the monitored subnets.

field.label: Auto-disable probing after (hours)
field.help: Turn probing back off this long after enabling it. 0 keeps it on indefinitely.

field.label: Scheduled report
field.help: Email a usage and anomaly summary on a schedule.

field.label: Recipients
field.help: Comma-separated addresses. Blank writes the report to the system log instead of mailing it (OPNsense has no system-wide notification recipient).

field.label: External history database
field.help: Offload durable history to an external PostgreSQL server. Requires a pgsql PHP extension, which OPNsense does not ship — see docs/POSTGRES.md.

field.label: Fine retention (days)
field.help: Roll per-interval rows older than this into daily totals. 0 keeps them forever.

field.label: Daily retention (days)
field.help: Delete daily totals older than this. 0 keeps them forever.
